findings.quote: It came out at two myriads and a fraction.
findings.problem: The wiki page 'Value, Coin and Trade' defines a myriad as a contracted delivery rate (one myriad delivered daily for a year, from a named source), not a spot quantity; the draft uses it as the total price of a single one-off dose. Unattested, not contradicted outright.
findings.fix: If intentional, add a line lampshading the conversion from rate to one-time quantity; otherwise confirm with Isaac whether 'myriad' doubles as a spot-price unit in this book.
